messages:
sophia: kicked off day-run across us-west / eu-west / apac1. running Llama2-7b + Vicuna-7b on A100 and H100. comparing q4_0 vs q8x4, seq lengths 64/256/512, batches 1/4/8. goal: kernel sensitivity + $/1M tokens delta. will post quick summary when jobs finish. :checkerboard:
eli: nice. are you using the same CUDA / driver stack across regions? want apples-to-apples.

sophia: yes — Ubuntu 22.04, cuda 12.1, driver 535.xx, runtime image rwinf-infer:v2.3. only difference is instance SKU (A100 40GB vs H100 80GB) and region-specific host SKU.

marcus: curious about prefill vs decode split. can you paste a tiny table when done?
sophia: sure — quick day-run summary (aggregated p50/p95 + tokens/sec + $/1M). note: numbers are medians across 3 runs each.

sophia: ```
Model         | GPU  | Seq | Batch | tokens/s | prefill p95 ms | decode p95 ms | $/1M tokens
Llama2-7b q8  | H100 | 64  | 1     | 5600     | 18             | 22            | $6.2
Llama2-7b q8  | A100 | 64  | 1     | 4200     | 26             | 35            | $7.9
Llama2-7b q4  | H100 | 512 | 1     | 1200     | 110            | 170           | $11.8
Llama2-7b q4  | A100 | 512 | 1     | 480      | 260            | 390           | $28.9
Vicuna-7b q4  | H100 | 256 | 4     | 3100     | 48             | 60            | $8.0
Vicuna-7b q4  | A100 | 256 | 4     | 1300     | 120            | 190           | $19.5
```

eli: woah that A100 q4 numbers are rough for seq512. any kernel fallbacks in the logs?
sophia: yes — observed kernel fallbacks on A100 at seq>=512 and batch=1 for q4 runs. H100 stuck to optimized flash/kernels. snippet from runtime log:

sophia: ```
[2026-03-18T09:14:02Z] kernel_select: chosen flash_attn_v2 kernel_id=0x7 for seq=256,gpu=H100
[2026-03-18T09:14:22Z] kernel_select: fallback -> generic_attention kernel_id=0x01 for seq=512,gpu=A100 (reason: mem_layout_mismatch)
[2026-03-18T09:14:22Z] perf_warning: decode_latency x2.3 vs baseline
```

kai: did infra surface thermal or GPU clock downscaling events? sometimes A100s in apac SKU run in conservative clocks under sustained loads.

infra-bot: node-run-3521129999: apac1-a100-ppn3 reported thermal_throttle event at 2026-03-18T09:12:58Z. avg gpu_util=93%, power_limit=250W.

sophia: that matches the worst-run window. eu-west H100 cluster had one short thermal event but scheduler migrated two pods and kernel stayed optimized.

qa-lab: on quality — we ran evals against 2k prompt eval set. q4_0 showed +2.6% perplexity on Vicuna-7b (notable on math prompts), q8x4 +0.3%. recommend we don't promote q4_0 for Vicuna until we have targeted prompt-level checks.

marcus: actionable summary?
sophia: short: 1) For seq>256 prefer routing to H100 (latency and kernel stability). 2) For cost-sensitive short-seq workloads q8x4 on A100 is fine. 3) Avoid q4_0 for Vicuna in prod until evals addressed. 4) Infra: investigate apac A100 thermal config / power cap.

kai: I'll add a routing policy patch: `route: prefer_gpu: H100 when seq >= 256 or p95_target_ms < 200` and start canary ASAP.

marcus: also add a runtime tweak: try enabling `kv_prefill_cache=true` for hot-prefix workloads, that shaves prefill p95 by ~20% on H100.

eli: can you open a tiny follow-up ticket with the run artifacts and logs? need exact kernels chosen per run so we can correlate with kernel git hashes.

sophia: done — uploaded run artifacts to s3://rwinf-ml-qa/iso-dayrun/3521129999/ and created ticket INF-7821 with logs + perf traces. will schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow. :calendar:

kai: thanks — high-level this suggests we keep H100 for long-seq and high-p95 SLOs, use A100 for short bursts and cheaper q8 configs. good notes. :thumbsup:
